source: AWS public on-demand list prices for us-east-1 (aws.amazon.com/rds/postgresql/pricing, aws.amazon.com/elasticache/pricing, aws.amazon.com/fargate/pricing, aws.amazon.com/secrets-manager/pricing, aws.amazon.com/vpc/pricing), cross-checked against instances.vantage.sh; approximate, hourly rate x 730 h

items.label: Public IPv4 address per worker task

fixed.label: ECS cluster, VPC, subnets, internet gateway, security groups

notes: Approximate on-demand list prices for us-east-1, 730 h/month; other regions are typically 5-25% higher.
multiplier: factor applied to an item when its multiplier_variable (db_multi_az) is true.

Excludes data transfer, CloudWatch Logs ingestion/storage ($0.50/GB ingested), Secrets Manager API calls, RDS backup storage beyond the free allowance (100% of provisioned storage), retained final snapshots and gp3 IOPS/throughput above the baseline.
Fargate prices are for X86_64; worker_cpu_architecture = ARM64 is about 20% cheaper.
Public IPv4 charge applies while worker_assign_public_ip = true (the default with the module-created VPC). The NAT gateway alternative costs ~$32.85/month per gateway plus $0.045/GB processed.
Reserved instances / Savings Plans can lower RDS, ElastiCache and Fargate costs substantially.
